definitions.gloss: mushroom picking; mushroom hunting; mushroom foraging
definitions.explanation: The recreational activity of going into the woods or mountains to gather wild mushrooms. A popular autumn pastime in Japan.

examples.english: I go mushroom picking in autumn.

examples.japanese: {茸狩|きのこが}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{松茸|まつたけ}→松茸：13119_matsutake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found matsutake mushrooms while mushroom hunting.

examples.japanese: {茸狩|きのこが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧きのこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: When mushroom picking, you must be careful of poisonous mushrooms.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{茸|きのこ}→茸：04994_kinoko⟧ (mushroom) + {狩|が}り (hunting, gathering). Part of a family of ～{狩|が}り compound words for gathering activities.

- {茸狩|きのこが}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧: mushroom picking season

CULTURAL NOTE:
Mushroom picking is a popular autumn activity in mountainous areas of Japan, typically from September to November. Japan has a rich mushroom culture, with prized species like ⟦{松茸|まつたけ}→松茸：13119_matsutake⟧ (matsutake), {椎茸|しいたけ} (shiitake), and ⟦{舞茸|まいたけ}→舞茸：20031_maitake⟧ (maitake). However, ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧きのこ (poisonous mushrooms) are a real hazard, and every year there are cases of poisoning from misidentified wild mushrooms. Also commonly written as きのこ{狩|が}り with hiragana for the mushroom part.
